```{=html}
<div class="steps-list">

 <article class="step-card" id="step-1">
  <div class="step-photo"><img src="/recipes/cauliflower-pork/images/prep.png" alt="准备食材"></div>
  <div class="step-body">
   <div class="step-head">
    <span class="step-num">01</span>
    <span class="step-title">准备食材</span>
    <span class="step-time"><i data-lucide="clock"></i>5 分</span>
   </div>
   <ol class="step-list">
    <li>菜花掰成小朵，根部稍粗的可以用刀劈成两半。流水冲洗，再用淡盐水泡 5 分钟，沥干备用。</li>
    <li>猪里脊先<strong>顺纹理</strong>切成约 3 毫米厚的薄片，再叠起来切成 3 毫米粗、4–5 cm 长的<strong>肉丝</strong>。</li>
    <li>蒜切片，干辣椒剪小段去籽，葱白和葱绿分开切。</li>
   </ol>
   <div class="step-tip"><i data-lucide="lightbulb"></i><span>菜花的小朵大小尽量一致，这样下锅炒时熟得均匀。</span></div>
  </div>
 </article>

 <article class="step-card" id="step-2">
  <div class="step-photo"><img src="/recipes/cauliflower-pork/images/marinating.png" alt="腌制肉丝"></div>
  <div class="step-body">
   <div class="step-head">
    <span class="step-num">02</span>
    <span class="step-title">腌制肉丝</span>
    <span class="step-time"><i data-lucide="clock"></i>10 分</span>
   </div>
   <ol class="step-list">
    <li>切好的肉丝放入碗中，加入 1 汤匙料酒、半汤匙生抽、1 汤匙淀粉。</li>
    <li>用手抓匀，让每根肉丝都裹上一层薄薄的浆。再淋几滴食用油，可以防止肉丝下锅时粘连。</li>
    <li>静置 10 分钟，让淀粉吸收水分，下锅时肉更滑嫩。</li>
   </ol>
   <div class="step-tip"><i data-lucide="lightbulb"></i><span>淀粉抓码是肉丝嫩滑不柴的关键，宁可多一点也不要少。</span></div>
  </div>
 </article>

 <article class="step-card" id="step-3">
  <div class="step-photo"><img src="/recipes/cauliflower-pork/images/blanching.png" alt="焯水菜花"></div>
  <div class="step-body">
   <div class="step-head">
    <span class="step-num">03</span>
    <span class="step-title">焯水菜花</span>
    <span class="step-time"><i data-lucide="clock"></i>3 分</span>
   </div>
   <ol class="step-list">
    <li>锅中加水烧开，加入半茶匙盐和几滴食用油。</li>
    <li>菜花下锅煮 1 分钟左右，看到颜色变得鲜亮、边缘微软即可捞出。</li>
    <li>立刻过一遍冷水（或冰水），沥干水分备用。</li>
   </ol>
   <div class="step-warn"><i data-lucide="triangle-alert"></i><span>不要焯太久，菜花断生即可，下一步还要下锅炒。</span></div>
  </div>
 </article>

 <article class="step-card" id="step-4">
  <div class="step-photo"><img src="/recipes/cauliflower-pork/images/stir-frying-pork.png" alt="滑炒肉丝"></div>
  <div class="step-body">
   <div class="step-head">
    <span class="step-num">04</span>
    <span class="step-title">滑炒肉丝</span>
    <span class="step-time"><i data-lucide="clock"></i>3 分</span>
   </div>
   <ol class="step-list">
    <li>锅烧热，倒入 1 汤匙食用油，油温五成热（轻微冒烟前）。</li>
    <li>把肉丝抖散下锅，不要一坨倒下去。中火快炒至肉丝变白、表面微微发亮。</li>
    <li>盛出备用，锅里留底油。</li>
   </ol>
   <div class="step-tip"><i data-lucide="lightbulb"></i><span>肉丝下锅后先别急着翻动，让一面定型 10 秒再划散，根根分明不会粘成一团。</span></div>
  </div>
 </article>

 <article class="step-card" id="step-5">
  <div class="step-photo"><img src="/recipes/cauliflower-pork/images/combining.png" alt="爆香合炒"></div>
  <div class="step-body">
   <div class="step-head">
    <span class="step-num">05</span>
    <span class="step-title">爆香合炒</span>
    <span class="step-time"><i data-lucide="clock"></i>4 分</span>
   </div>
   <ol class="step-list">
    <li>锅中留底油，需要的话再补 1 汤匙食用油。下蒜片和葱白，中小火炒 10 秒。下干辣椒段，再炒 10 秒，闻到香味、辣椒微微发深即可。</li>
    <li>沥干的菜花倒入锅中，转大火翻炒 1 分钟，让菜花裹上油香。</li>
    <li>加入半汤匙生抽、半茶匙老抽和半茶匙盐，继续翻炒 30 秒。</li>
    <li>把之前盛出的肉丝倒回锅中，快速翻炒 30 秒，让所有食材均匀混合。</li>
   </ol>
   <div class="step-warn"><i data-lucide="triangle-alert"></i><span>干辣椒最怕炒糊，火稍微小一点。糊了会发苦，整道菜都会受影响。</span></div>
   <div class="step-tip"><i data-lucide="lightbulb"></i><span>老抽是上色用的，分量很少就够了。多了颜色会发暗，菜花的清爽感会被压住。</span></div>
  </div>
 </article>

 <article class="step-card" id="step-6">
  <div class="step-photo"><img src="/recipes/cauliflower-pork/images/plating.png" alt="出锅装盘"></div>
  <div class="step-body">
   <div class="step-head">
    <span class="step-num">06</span>
    <span class="step-title">出锅装盘</span>
    <span class="step-time"><i data-lucide="clock"></i>1 分</span>
   </div>
   <ol class="step-list">
    <li>关火，撒上葱绿，用余温稍微焖一下。</li>
    <li>盛入盘中即可，趁热吃口感最好。</li>
   </ol>
  </div>
 </article>

</div>
```
